 Fort Bend County District Court
 Cause No. 2025-CV-0036
 Maria Juarez, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
9-15-25
Counsel for defendant:
Stephanie Williams, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant generally denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and demands strict
proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence, as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure.
Subject to and without waiving the foregiong denial, Defendant asserts the following affirmative defenses.
First, Defednant asserts proportionate responsibility under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies
Code. Plaintiff's own negligence, including failure to yield the right-of-way at the intersection and failure to keep a
proper lookout, caused or contributed to the collision. Any recovery must be reduced by Plaintiff's percentage of
responsibility, and Defendant requests that the trier of fact apportion responsibility among all responsible parties.
Second, Defendant asserts sole proximate cause. The collision and resulting injuries, if any, were caused solely by
the acts or omissions of Plaintiff or of a third party over whom Defendant had no control, and not by any negligence of
Defendant.
Third, Defendant asserts failure to mitigate damages. Plaintiff failed to exercise reasonable care to minimize his or
her alleged damages, including by failing to follow recommended medical treatment, and any recovery must be
reduced accordingly.
</page>

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
